title: Cat-a-Comb: our cats already chose this bed, so let's build it
subtitle: A cat bed that is also a tunnel: a rectangular wood frame around a removable U-shaped foam cradle. Our cats found the shape themselves in an improvised version; this brief proposes three designs and a prototype plan.
summary: Our cats love an improvised setup: a foam mat folded into a U inside the wooden base of a coffee table, and a gap walled in by books. Cat-a-Comb turns it into a product: a wood frame with a removable foam sling that bends into a U, open at both ends, as an Open Cradle, a Closed Tunnel or a bookshelf variant. The ask is to prototype the two simplest variants and trial them with other cats.
key_findings: Two of our cats choose an improvised version: a U-folded foam mat inside a wooden frame, and a gap walled by books.
Concept: a wood frame plus a flexible foam sling in a zip-off, washable cover, open at both ends (bed and tunnel).
Review fix: specify inside size. The boards' 10″ outside width leaves ~8½″ inside; at least 11″ is recommended.
Safety and practicality: enclosed foam with a hidden zip, non-toxic finish, non-slip feet, no loose books, flat-pack shipping.
The ask: a cardboard size check, then prototypes of the two simplest variants and a home trial with colleagues' cats.
data_sources: Photos of our cats at home
